question:
The following pie diagram shows the total expenditure (in percentage) incurred by 'X' in one month. Answer the given question based on the pie diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d00fc763c864208664e3cc66fcf1dd40f5b42a6ff012db4f9f2cb9364f4332.png] 

If X decides to save money and reduce expenditure uniformly by 20% on all heads, what would be the CHANGE in the percentage share of Education in the total expenditure incurred by X?
solution:
Calculation:

The percentage share of Education in the total expenditure incurred by X = {{37.5 - 37.5times 80\%} over {100 - 100 times 80\%}} times 100\% = 37.5%
